best_idea: One signed stamina pool that every action spends from, with dodge value scaled by a logistic of the pool and refused below a floor, so tiredness shows up as lost dodges and dearer runs before it shows up as a stop.
decision_why: Frankendom's melee economy (guard, parry, stamina) needs one pool with a weight-and-skill swing cost and a stamina-scaled dodge. Adapt: keep the pool, the swing cost with its floor, the dodge scale and refusal floor, and the winded state; fix the block cost sign; leave out the cardio accumulator and stimulants at first. Server must own the pool.
acceptance: Duel test with a pool of 8,500 (donor default): a 1,600 g swing at melee 0 costs 150; a dodge at 25% stamina is refused; at 50% it is allowed at half value; a swing that takes the pool below zero marks the fighter winded and refuses the next dodge.
